title: 第230章 问此间（五十八）
content_zh:
刘扶光还在思索那见鬼的日食是什么来头,听见晏欢这么说，顿时黑了脸，道：“晏欢,客气点。”
晏欢心不在焉地伸出两根手指，剑锋卡进食指与中指的第一指节，便如卡进了坚不可摧的泰山，剑尖纹丝不动,休想往前分毫。
龙神上下打量着年轻的王,十多年如一日,爱侣与这凡人置身在同一时空，朝夕相对，哪怕这是观世镜的诡计,晏欢仍旧手痒牙更痒,只想按照前一次的死法,再来一套千刀万剐的小游戏。
“地上天国？”晏欢玩味地笑道,“凡人,难道你也想做哲人王么？”
赤水王面色一变,知晓自己的剖白已经被眼前不祥的男人听见，他想呼唤侍卫,但不知为何，他就像着了魔一样,回答了这个男人的问题。
“我不知道你在说什么,我和你这样的……不是一路人,立刻离开我的王宫，我的国家！”
“魔鬼的愿望，当然只能引来魔鬼本尊。”转念一想，晏欢松开手指，倒是察觉出了一点趣味。他缓缓踱步，在刘扶光身边徘徊，“怎么了，难道你不想终结自己的噩梦，不愿实现自己的理想吗？”
镜子分批次地将他们投入这里，与赤水王单独面对面，其中肯定有什么门道。
“只要你点头，我就可以帮你，想想吧，你的心愿，还有你那美妙的世界……”
赤水王忌惮地望着他，徒劳地挥舞着手中的长剑：“滚开，魔头，滚开！”
见他如此模样，晏欢发出轻柔的长笑，直听得人毛骨悚然：“当然，我不急，等你想通了，自然会来求我！”
站在暗处，晏欢旁观着赤水王到处戒备的姿态，只等着他狠狠倒霉。刘扶光叹道：“你这又是何必。”
听见爱侣的叹息，晏欢慢慢地咬紧了牙关，妒忌的毒液，油煎火燎地折腾着他的心。
先前他就在思索，旱神所说的交易，是与谁的交易？他看着刘扶光的眼神，说至善迟来时的语气，还有要带刘扶光离开的动作……爱情使人千百倍的敏锐，晏欢嗅出了分外微妙的气味，因此看待旱神的前世，也是恨不得啖之而后快的态度。
“……你心疼了？”他压低声音，将这句红醋腌了八百年，满含怨气的酸话脱口而出。
问完这句话，晏欢又觉得后悔，接着找补道：“不，我不是这个……”
“你管我心疼谁，总归不会心疼你。”刘扶光淡淡回道，“怎么样，满意了吗？”
content_en:
Liu Fuguang was still thinking about the origin of that damn solar eclipse. When he heard what Yan Huan said, his face turned dark and he said, "Yan Huan, be polite."
Yan Huan absent-mindedly stretched out two fingers. The blade of the sword got stuck on the first knuckles of his index and middle fingers. It was as if it was stuck in an indestructible mountain. The tip of the sword did not move at all, and there was no way he could move forward.
The Dragon God looked at the young king up and down. For more than ten years, his lover and this mortal were in the same time and space, facing each other day and night. Even if this was a trick of the world-viewing mirror, Yan Huan still felt itchy and wanted to play the same little game of death with a thousand cuts.
"Heaven on earth?" Yan Huan smiled playfully, "Mortal, do you also want to be a philosopher king?"
King Chishui's expression changed, knowing that his confession had been heard by the ominous man in front of him. He wanted to call the guards, but for some reason, he answered the man's question as if he was possessed.
"I don't know what you are talking about. You and I... are not the same person. Leave my palace and my country immediately!"
"Of course the devil's wish can only attract the devil himself." After thinking about it, Yan Huan loosened his fingers and noticed something interesting. He walked slowly and hovered next to Liu Fuguang, "What's wrong? Don't you want to end your nightmare and realize your ideal?"
The mirror put them here in batches to face the Chishui King alone. There must be some way to it.
"As long as you nod, I can help you. Think about your wishes and your wonderful world..."
King Chishui looked at him fearfully and waved the sword in his hand in vain: "Get away, devil, get away!"
Seeing him like this, Yan Huan let out a soft long laugh, which made people's hair stand on end: "Of course, I'm not in a hurry. When you figure it out, you will naturally come to beg me!"
Standing in the dark, Yan Huan watched Chishui King's vigilant posture everywhere, just waiting for him to suffer severe misfortune. Liu Fuguang sighed: "Why are you doing this?"
Hearing his lover's sigh, Yan Huan slowly clenched his teeth, the venom of jealousy gnawing at his heart.
He had been thinking about it before, who was the deal the Drought God was talking about? The look in his eyes as he looked at Liu Fuguang, the tone in which he said the benevolence was late, and the move to take Liu Fuguang away... Love makes people a thousand times more sensitive. Yan Huan smelled a particularly subtle smell, so he looked at the drought god's previous life with the attitude of eager to taste it.
"...Are you distressed?" He lowered his voice, marinated this sentence in red vinegar for eight hundred years, and blurted out the sour words full of resentment.
After asking this question, Yan Huan felt regretful again, and then added: "No, I am not like this..."
"You don't care who I feel sorry for, I won't feel sorry for you anyway." Liu Fuguang replied calmly, "How is it, are you satisfied?"
